proposal.singleHost: Move ownership of the existing sole P01 host to authenticated/unauthenticated application lifetime; AppPluginSession borrows it through precise disposable business registrations. No second host or registry.
proposal.preauth: Only reviewed bundled builtin definitions and local appearance; not all Workspace plugins or center-loaded packages. Trust cannot come from self-declared plugin ID.
proposal.privateActions: Connect contribution requests host-owned form submit with no arguments; token, CSRF, cookie, FlowClient and journal stay private. Button and Enter share the existing ConnectionSession action.
proposal.postauth: Bind business lease only after authoritative session/namespace/generation checks and retained guard; invalidate lease synchronously before async transitions. Existing private domain authorization remains authoritative.
proposal.retained: Reauthentication view can coexist with retained Workspace state; revoke reads/writes without discarding draft/materials/pending capture/unknown receipt. Explicit discard keeps original confirmation.
proposal.renderer: Use real ExtensionSlot and PluginView consumers for existing settings.sections/Appearance; DOM marker or fake AppPluginSession is insufficient.
proposal.disable: Deactivate/unregister must remove contribution and old callbacks; precise old lease cleanup must not dispose shared host or new registrations. Do not silently reactivate disabled entries.
proposal.trustBoundary: Same-realm trusted builtin model does not establish arbitrary third-party code isolation.
